exercises.title: Accessible sign-up rewrite

A neighborhood blood drive posts a simple sign-up page, built without much thought for accessibility. Before it goes live, the markup must satisfy five rules:

Example: after a correct fix, `document.querySelector('header').contains(document.querySelector('h1'))` is `true`, and the sign-up control's tag name is `BUTTON`.

exercises.title: Warehouse PIN Gate
exercises.prompt:
A warehouse scanner asks a worker to type a PIN before it will log a shipment. The page has a form with id `pinForm` containing a text input `pin` and a submit button, plus two empty paragraphs, `error` and `result`.

Write the script so that submitting the form stops the normal page reload, then checks these problems in order and stops at the first one found:
- `pin` is empty: set `error` to `Enter a PIN` and clear `result`.
- `pin` is not exactly 4 characters: set `error` to `PIN must be 4 digits`.
- `pin` contains anything other than digits: set `error` to `Digits only`.

If none of these apply, clear `error` and set `result` to `Logged: <pin>`.

Example: submitting `77` shows `PIN must be 4 digits` in `error`. Submitting `4471` sets `result` to `Logged: 4471` and clears `error`.

tests.name: too short
valid pin
empty pin
letters mixed in
too long
leading zeros
recovers after fix

exercises.referenceSolution:
<script>
  document.getElementById('pinForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    const pin = document.getElementById('pin').value
    const error = document.getElementById('error')
    const result = document.getElementById('result')
    if (pin.length === 0) {
      error.textContent = 'Enter a PIN'
      result.textContent = ''
      return
    }
    if (pin.length !== 4) {
      error.textContent = 'PIN must be 4 digits'
      result.textContent = ''
      return
    }
    if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(pin)) {
      error.textContent = 'Digits only'
      result.textContent = ''
      return
    }
    error.textContent = ''
    result.textContent = 'Logged: ' + pin
  })
</script>

exercises.title: Ingredient Line Cleanup
exercises.prompt:
A recipe app lets a cook paste one line of ingredients separated by semicolons, sometimes with extra spaces or repeated semicolons, such as `2 cups flour;; 1 tsp salt ;3 eggs `. The page has a text input `line`, a button `format`, and two empty paragraphs, `result` and `error`.

Write the script so that clicking `format`:
- splits the text on `;`,
- trims whitespace from each piece,
- drops any piece that becomes empty,
- if nothing is left, sets `error` to `No ingredients found` and clears `result`,
- otherwise clears `error` and sets `result` to the remaining pieces rejoined with `, `.

Example: `2 cups flour;; 1 tsp salt ;3 eggs ` becomes `2 cups flour, 1 tsp salt, 3 eggs` in `result`. An input of only `; ; ;` shows `No ingredients found`.

tests.name: messy line cleans up
only separators
single ingredient
leading and trailing separators
empty input
many ingredients
recovers after fix

exercises.referenceSolution:
<script>
  document.getElementById('format').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const raw = document.getElementById('line').value
    const pieces = raw.split(';').map(p => p.trim()).filter(p => p.length > 0)
    const result = document.getElementById('result')
    const error = document.getElementById('error')
    if (pieces.length === 0) {
      error.textContent = 'No ingredients found'
      result.textContent = ''
      return
    }
    error.textContent = ''
    result.textContent = pieces.join(', ')
  })
</script>

  function subtotal(qty) {
    return PRICE * qty
  }

  function applyDiscount(amount, code) {
    return code === 'SAVE10' ? amount * 0.9 : amount

  function formatCurrency(amount) {
    return '$' + amount.toFixed(2)

</script>

exercises.referenceSolution:
<script>
  let step = 1
  const back = document.getElementById('back')
  const next = document.getElementById('next')

  function render() {
    document.getElementById('step-1').hidden = step !== 1
    document.getElementById('step-2').hidden = step !== 2
    document.getElementById('step-3').hidden = step !== 3
    document.getElementById('step-label').textContent = 'Step ' + step + ' of 3'
    back.disabled = step === 1
    next.disabled = step === 3
  }

  back.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (step > 1) step -= 1
    render()
  })

  next.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (step < 3) step += 1
    render()
  })

  render()
</script>
